19103.meaning1: encouragement and instruction; exhortation and teaching

examples.text: kiṃ pana maṃ tvaṃ, sunakkhatta, evaṃ vadesi, rakkhat'etaṃ, bhante, bhagavā vācaṃ, rakkhat'etaṃ sugato vācan'ti? bhagavatā c'assa, bhante, esā vācā ek'aṃsena ovāditā, abhabbo acelo pāthikaputto taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā mama sammukhībhāvaṃ āgantuṃ.

19108.meaning1: approaching for the sake of instruction

examples.text: anvaddhamāsaṃ bhikkhuniyā bhikkhusaṅghato dve dhammā paccāsīsitabbā uposathapucchakañ'ca ovād'upasaṅkamanañ'ca

19109.meaning1: approaching for instruction; visiting for advice

19111.grammar: prp of caus of ava √var, caus, trans (+acc)
19111.commentary: (DNa) ovārento'ti āvārento. thero kira pakatiyā'pi mahāsarīro hatthipotakasadiso. so paṃsukūlacīvaraṃ pārupitvā atimahā viya ahosi.

examples.text: ayañ'ca mahesakkho bhikkhu bhagavato purato ṭhito ovārento, na mayaṃ labhāma pacchime kāle tathāgataṃ dassanāyā'ti.
ato mahantatarena, aggivessana, avijjākhandhena jayaseno rājakumāro āvuto nivuṭo ovuṭo pariyonaddho.

19113.meaning2: rained upon; exposed to the rain

examples.text: ayaṃ loko kena āvuto nivuto ovuto, pihito paṭicchanno paṭikujjito'ti, kenassu nivuto loko?

19119.synonym: upadhāna, upādhi, bibbohana, bibbohanā, bimbohana, bimbohanā, bhisi

examples.text: himavā pabbatarājā bibbohanaṃ [bibbohanaṃ, bimba + ohanaṃ = iti padavibhāgo] ahosi
tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu adhimattā vātā muddhani ohananti.
kim'assa ussāraṇāya? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ araññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā mātugāmo upasaṅkamitvā ohasati ullapati ujjagghati uppaṇḍeti.
tā upenti vividhena chandasā, citrabimbamukhiyo alaṅ'katā, ohasanti pahasanti nāriyo, sambaro'va satamāyakovidā.
ahañ'c'eva kho pana yādisake kāme ohāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito tādisake vā kāme pariyeseyyaṃ tato vā pāpiṭṭhatare, na m'etaṃ patirūpan'ti.

19128.meaning2: having caused to be removed, having had removed

examples.text: etaṃ daḷhaṃ bandhanam'āhu dhīrā, ohārinaṃ sithilaṃ duppamuñcaṃ, etam'pi chetvāna paribbajanti, anapekkhino kāmasukhaṃ pahāya.
sāvatthinidānaṃ. seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, nadī pabbateyyā ohārinī dūraṅ'gamā sīghasotā.

19133.commentary: (UDa) ohāretvā voropetvā (ITIa) kesamassuṃ ohāretvā'ti kese ca massuñca ohāretvā apanetvā.

examples.text: atha kho bho mahāgovindo brāhmaṇo tassa satt'āhassa accayena kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbaji
yaṃnūn'āhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyan'ti.

19134.meaning1: put down; placed down; laid down

examples.text: pariciṇṇo mayā satthā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ, ohito garuko bhāro, bhavanetti samūhatā.
yo so, bhante, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇ'āsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano samma'd'aññāvimutto, so cha ṭhānāni adhimutto hoti
dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati n'ādhimuccati na sampasīdati, kos'ohite ca vatthaguyhe, pahūtajivhatāya ca.
aṭṭhīnaṃ nagaraṃ kataṃ, maṃsalohitalepanaṃ, yattha jarā ca maccu ca, māno makkho ca ohito.
te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasi katvā sabbacetasā samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti

19137.meaning1: who has put down the burden; who has laid down the load; epithet of an arahant
19137.commentary: (SNa) khandhabhāro kilesabhāro abhisaṅkhārabhāro kāmaguṇabhāro'ti, ime ohitā bhārā etesan'ti ohitabhārā.

examples.text: yo so, bhante, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇ'āsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano samma'd'aññāvimutto, so cha ṭhānāni adhimutto hoti
khīṇ'āsavassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno vusitavato katakaraṇīyassa ohitabhārassa anuppattasadatthassa parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojanassa samma'd'aññāvimuttassa ayam'anudhammo hoti veyyākaraṇāya
te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasi katvā sabbacetasā samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti
kathāsampayogena, bhikkhave, puggalo veditabbo yadi vā saupaniso yadi vā anupaniso'ti. anohitasoto, bhikkhave, anupaniso hoti, ohitasoto saupaniso hoti.

19139.meaning1: having stayed back; having remained behind

19140.meaning1: staying behind; left behind; remaining behind
19140.commentary: (VINa) ohiyyako'ti avahīyako avaseso, vihāravāraṃ patvā eko'va vihāre ṭhito'ti attho. (SNa) ohiyyako'ti ohīnako.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā gāmaṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭho hoti. āyasmā udāyī ohiyyako hoti vihārapālo.
tena kho pana samayena āyasmā vaṅg'īso navako hoti acirapabbajito ohiyyako vihārapālo.

19141.meaning1: stays behind; remains behind; lags back

examples.text: yattha ṭhito suṇāti, āpatti pācittiyassa. pacchato gacchanto turito gacchati sossāmī'ti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. yattha ṭhito suṇāti, āpatti pācittiyassa. purato gacchanto ohiyyati sossāmī'ti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

19143.meaning2: who remains or is left behind

19148.meaning1: having stayed back; having remained behind

examples.text: ayañ'ca dasasahassī lokadhātu saṅkampi sampakampi sampavedhi appamāṇo ca oḷāro obhāso loke pāturahosi atikkamm'eva devānaṃ dev'ānubhāvaṃ.
puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu dhammakāmo hoti piyasamudāhāro, abhidhamme abhivinaye oḷārapāmojjo.

19153.synonym: āmisa, kabaliṅkāra, kabaḷiṅkāra, kabaḷiṃkāra, kabaḷīkāra, kavaḷīkāra, thulla, thūla, rūpavant, rūpī

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ atīt'ānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā, sabbaṃ rūpaṃ, n'etaṃ mama, n'eso'ham'asmi, na m'eso attā'ti evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ
evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, santi adhicittam'anuyuttassa bhikkhuno oḷārikā upakkilesā kāyaduccaritaṃ vacīduccaritaṃ manoduccaritaṃ
tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, na kho taṃ sukaraṃ sukhaṃ adhigantuṃ evaṃ adhimattakasimānaṃ pattakāyena, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhāreyyaṃ odanakummāsan'ti.

cattāro'me, bhikkhave, āhārā bhūtānaṃ vā sattānaṃ ṭhitiyā sambhav'esīnaṃ vā anuggahāya. katame cattāro? kabaḷīkāro āhāro oḷāriko vā sukhumo vā, phasso dutiyo, manosañcetanā tatiyā, viññāṇaṃ catutthaṃ.

19155.commentary: (ANa) oḷigallan'ti tesaṃ'y'eva kaddam'ādīnaṃ sandan'okāsaṃ. taṃ jaṇṇumattam'pi asucibharitaṃ hoti.

examples.text: caṇḍaṃ kukkuraṃ parivajjeti, ahiṃ khāṇuṃ kaṇṭakaṭṭhānaṃ sobbhaṃ papātaṃ candanikaṃ oḷigallaṃ
katamā ca, sāriputta, saṃsedajā yoni? ye kho te, sāriputta, sattā pūtimacche vā jāyanti pūtikuṇape vā pūtikummāse vā candanikāye vā oḷigalle vā jāyanti, ayaṃ vuccati, sāriputta, saṃsedajā yoni.

19157.meaning2: of whatever kind; of some kind or other

examples.text: avijjam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sāhāraṃ vadāmi, no anāhāraṃ. ko c'āhāro avijjāya?

ko sujjhati muccati bajjhatī ca, ken'attanā gacchati brahmalokaṃ, ajānato me muni brūhi puṭṭho, bhagavā hi me sakkhi brahmajjadiṭṭho, tuvañ'hi no brahmasamo'si saccaṃ, kathaṃ upapajjati brahmalokaṃ jutima.

19159.commentary: (MNa) kā gatī'ti kā nipphatti. (UDa) tassa kā gatī'ti pañcasu gatīsu tassa katamā gati upapatti bhavabhūtā, gatī'ti nipphatti, ariyo puthujjano vā'ti kā niṭṭhā'ti attho.

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ, yo so, bhante, pukkusāti nāma kulaputto bhagavatā saṃkhittena ovādena ovadito so kālaṅ'kato. tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo'ti?
(ka) katamo eko dhammo bahukāro? appamādo kusalesu dhammesu. ayaṃ eko dhammo bahukāro.

19162.synonym: ambu, uda, udaka, oka, oda, odaka, jala, toya, daka, ninnaga, vāri, salila

examples.text: ubhatodaṇḍakena ce'pi, bhikkhave, kakacena corā ocarakā aṅgam'aṅgāni okanteyyuṃ, tatrā'pi yo mano padūseyya, na me so tena sāsanakaro.

19164.meaning2: like the teeth of a saw

19165.meaning1: containing the simile of the saw
19165.meaning2: containing the example of the saw

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, imaṃ kakac'ūpamaṃ ovādaṃ abhikkhaṇaṃ manasikarotha. taṃ vo bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā'ti.

19166.meaning2: instruction using the example of the saw

19167.meaningLit: discourse on the simile of the saw

examples.text: imañ'ca tumhe, bhikkhave, kakac'ūpamaṃ ovādaṃ abhikkhaṇaṃ manasi kareyyātha. passatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, taṃ vacanapathaṃ, aṇuṃ vā thūlaṃ vā, yaṃ tumhe n'ādhivāseyyāthā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
vuttaṃ kho pan'etaṃ bhagavatā kakac'ūpam'ovāde, ubhatodaṇḍakena ce'pi, bhikkhave, kakacena corā ocarakā aṅgam'aṅgāni okanteyyuṃ, tatrā'pi yo mano padūseyya na me so tena sāsanakaro'ti.

19169.meaning1: exhortation with the simile of the saw

examples.text: vuttaṃ kho pan'etaṃ bhagavatā kakac'ūpam'ovāde, ubhatodaṇḍakena ce'pi, bhikkhave, kakacena corā ocarakā aṅgam'aṅgāni okanteyyuṃ, tatrā'pi yo mano padūseyya na me so tena sāsanakaro'ti.

19170.meaning2: containing the example of the saw

19171.meaning2: sutta containing the example of the saw

examples.text: avipariṇāmadhammo'ti attano pakatibhāvaṃ avijahanadhammo, kakaṇṭako viya nānappakārataṃ n'āpajjati.
tena kho pana samayena pañcamattāni accharāsatāni sakkassa devānam'indassa upaṭṭhānaṃ āgatāni honti kakuṭapādāni.

19177.meaning2: kind of bird, perhaps a wild cock

19179.commentary: (SNa) kakudho devaputto'ti ayaṃ kira kolanagare mahāmoggallānattherassa upaṭṭhākaputto daharakāle'y'eva therassa santike vasanto jhānaṃ nibbattetvā kālaṅ'kato, brahmaloke uppajji. tatrā'pi naṃ kakudho brahmātv'eva sañjānanti.

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho kakudho devaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, nandasi, samaṇā'ti?

so kira vesālinagaradvāre ekaṃ kakudharukkhaṃ āruyha dvīhi pādehi rukkhasākhaṃ gaṇhitvā adhosiro olambanto kapilānaṃ me sataṃ detha, kahāpaṇe detha, paricārikaṃ detha, no ce dassatha, ito patitvā maranto nagaraṃ anagaraṃ karissāmī'ti vadati. tathāgatassa bhikkhusaṅghaparivutassa nagaraṃ pavisanakāle bhikkhū taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ disvā nikkhamanakāle'pi naṃ tath'eva olambantaṃ passiṃsu.
sujātā nāma, bhante, upāsikā nātike kālaṅ'katā, tassā kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo? kakudho nāma, bhante, upāsako nātike kālaṅ'kato, tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo?

19184.sanskrit: kakuda, kakubha, kakud + sthāvira + sūkta, sūtra (bsk)

19185.meaning2: ensign of royalty, five regalia,(viz. diadem, sword, canopy, slippers and yak's tail chowry)

examples.text: taṃ cakkacchinnaṃ udakaṃ parittaṃ luḷitaṃ āvilaṃ sandati. ayaṃ, bhante, kakudhā nadī avidūre acch'odakā sāt'odakā sīt'odakā set'odakā supatitthā ramaṇīyā. ettha bhagavā pānīyañ'ca pivissati gattāni ca sītīkarissatī'ti.

bhūtapubb'āhaṃ, pāpima, dūsī nāma māro ahosiṃ, tassa me kāḷī nāma bhaginī. tassā tvaṃ putto. so me tvaṃ bhāgineyyo ahosi. tena kho pana, pāpima, samayena kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti.

19191.meaning1: paste of fresh ground plant material; cleansing paste
19191.meaning2: paste, sediment deposited by oily substances
19191.commentary: (ANa) kakkan'ti āmalakakakkaṃ. tajjaṃ vāyāman'ti tajjātikaṃ tadanucchavikaṃ kakkena makkhana-ghaṃsana-dhovana-vāyāmaṃ.

examples.text: kathañ'ca, visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa sīsassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti? kakkañ'ca paṭicca mattikañ'ca paṭicca udakañ'ca paṭicca purisassa ca tajjaṃ vāyāmaṃ paṭicca, evaṃ kho, visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa sīsassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.

seyyathā'pi, bhante, gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre pokkharaṇī. tatr'āssa kakkaṭako. atha kho, bhante, sambahulā kumārakā vā kumārikā vā tamhā gāmā vā nigamā vā nikkhamitvā yena sā pokkharaṇī ten'upasaṅkameyyuṃ
kakkaṭako āha, mātula, ayaṃ saro etto, tvaṃ pana ito kiṃ nesī'ti?

19197.meaning2: ladder with hooks at one end for fastening it to a wall

19198.synonym: kakkhaḷa, khara, niṭṭhurī, pāpaka, pharusa, lūkhasa
19198.commentary: (MNa) kakkasā'ti pūtikā. yathā nāma pūtikarukkho kakkaso hoti paggharitacuṇṇo, evaṃ kakkasā hoti, sotaṃ ghaṃsamānā viya pavisati. tena vuttaṃ kakkasā'ti.

examples.text: pharusavāco hoti. yā sā vācā aṇḍakā kakkasā parakaṭukā par'ābhisajjanī kodhasāmantā asamādhisaṃvattanikā, tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti
